directAnswer: To update a URL shortener, access your account on the service's website, locate the shortened URL you wish to modify, and follow the provided options to edit or update it.
summary: This guide outlines the steps to update a shortened URL using popular URL shortener services.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: Updating a URL shortener allows you to change the destination link of an existing shortened URL. This can be useful for correcting mistakes or redirecting to new content.

sections.heading: Platform-Specific Steps
sections.body: The steps to update a URL may vary depending on the URL shortener service you are using. Below are general steps for some popular services.

sections.heading: Caveats
sections.body: Not all URL shorteners allow updates to existing links. Ensure you check the service's capabilities before attempting to modify a URL.

steps.title: Log into Your Account
steps.detail: Visit the URL shortener's website and log into your account using your credentials.

steps.title: Locate the Shortened URL
steps.detail: Navigate to your dashboard or link management section to find the URL you want to update.

steps.title: Edit the URL
steps.detail: Select the option to edit or update the link. Enter the new destination URL and save your changes.

steps.title: Verify the Update
steps.detail: Test the updated shortened URL to ensure it redirects to the correct new destination.

faqs.question: Can I change the destination of a shortened URL after it's been created?
faqs.answer: Yes, if the URL shortener service allows it, you can change the destination of a shortened URL.

faqs.question: Will updating a URL affect its analytics?
faqs.answer: Typically, updating a URL will retain its analytics, but it's best to check with your specific service.

faqs.question: What happens if I delete a shortened URL?
faqs.answer: Deleting a shortened URL will render it unusable, and any previous links will no longer work.

caveats: Some URL shorteners may not allow edits to existing links.
Changes may take time to propagate across the service.
